[LFST.4.1] Every event trace opens with a header,
`proto/stream_header.proto#StreamHeader` ([RFCS.4.2]). It records what the trace
was made against and by whom: the DS version that wrote it ([LFST.4.3]), the run
and tier identifiers ([LFST.4.4], [LFST.4.5]), the dialect binding
([LFST.4.6]), the compiled rule set's hash ([LFST.4.7]), the realtime contract's
hash ([RBND.1.4]) and the wall-clock instant the trace opened ([RFCS.4.8]). What a
reader requires of the header, and what it refuses, is [RFCS.4.7].
